hook: Shane Legg studied computer science at the University of Waikato and completed a master's degree at the University of Auckland before pursuing doctoral research at the Dalle Molle Institute for Artificial Intelligence Research (IDSIA) under Marcus Hutter. His PhD thesis, Machine Super Intelligence, set out an early formal research agenda for artificial general intelligence, and with Hutter he proposed a mathematical definition of machine intelligence that became a reference point for later work on measuring progress toward general AI. In 2010 he co-founded DeepMind Technologies with Demis Hassabis and Mustafa Suleyman, a company Google acquired in 2014. He has written publicly, including on his personal blog, about probabilistic forecasts for when machine intelligence might reach human levels. He was appointed Commander of the Order of the British Empire in 2019 for services to artificial intelligence. When DeepMind and Google's Brain team merged in April 2023 to form Google DeepMind, Legg remained part of the unit's core leadership group and continued his research role focused on artificial general intelligence.
